verdict.rationale: Morph's published OpenAPI document includes a model-listing endpoint, and the API reference renders a live 'Try it' runner for it against production. A separate machine-readable model feed also lists per-model ids, limits and pricing. But no evidence confirms the exact GET /v1/models path, an OpenAI-compatible response shape, or that the listing reflects the live catalog, and the feed is a website JSON rather than an API endpoint. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a GET /v1/models path and its response schema, confirmation that the listing is live and complete (including Reflex/tool models), independent or hands-on corroboration of agent enumeration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent enumerate the live model catalog programmatically via a documented GET /v1/models-style endpoint

citations.quote: OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible inference, Fast Apply, Compact, System One, model listing, dedicated endpoint management, credits and budgets (14 paths under /v1 and /api/v1)
The Mintlify API reference renders a live "Try it" runner per endpoint (System One, Apply/chat completions, Compact, models, dedicated endpoints, credits), generated from the OpenAPI document
For machine-readable models, limits and these list prices, fetch https://www.morphllm.com/api/models/json?prices=list
